coverFeeLabelWithAmount: Less a third-party processing fee of {{amount}}.
coverFeeModalHeader: Why is there a third-party processing fee?
coverFeeModalContentFirst: Banks and card companies charge charities, including Charitable Impact, a fee to process online donations. We don't set or benefit from this fee, but we do recover it. When you give to a charity from your Impact Account, the charity receives your gift minus this fee.
coverFeeModalContentSecond: However, Charitable Impact has access to lower bank and card fees than most other charity websites. This means more money can get to charity when you give from your Impact Account.
feeAmountCoveragePopup: Banks and card companies charge a processing fee to complete online transactions, including online donations.CHARITABLE IMPACT does not benefit from these fees, but we do pass them on to gift recipients. You can choose to cover this fee so the recipient receives 100% of your intended gift.
feeAmountCoverageNote: Couvrez {{feeAmount}} en frais de traitement par un tiers pour que l’organisme de bienfaisance reçoive le don de {{totalAmount}} en entier.
donationRecurringDateNote: Your first gift will be scheduled for {{recurringDate}}.
